raw_prediction_cost_C.timing_protocol: Bounded ordered two-worker option; no-grad/eval; FP32; same exact pixels; wait excludes overlapped loader work

raw_prediction_cost_V.timing_protocol: Bounded ordered two-worker option; no-grad/eval; FP32; same exact pixels; wait excludes overlapped loader work

inference_cost.timing_protocol: Bounded ordered two-worker option; no-grad/eval; FP32; same exact pixels; wait excludes overlapped loader work

input_timing_scope: Loader wait includes only non-overlapped delay; H2D uses blocking FP32 tensor transfer; model compute CUDA intervals unchanged

host_memory_observation.method: monitored process RSS; OS CPU affinity separately enforced; no claimed OS memory hard limit

peak_cuda_scope: Allocated tensors from fitting reset through C/V prediction and compact-model full pixel replay; not driver total/reserved memory
CUDA_timing_policy: Sum of CUDA-event model-forward/backward and clip/optimizer intervals, recorded after pixel load; includes dispatch/synchronization gaps within those intervals, excludes pixel decode/cache/transfer and checkpoint I/O
